description: MAC address vendor lookup (IEEE OUI registry via macvendors.com): returns the registered hardware vendor for a MAC address or OUI prefix. Public free API; vendor name only, no device data. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

mac.description: MAC address or OUI, e.g. 44:38:39:ff:ef:57 or 443839

title: B2b Macvendors Lookup
